name: Nova Desktop Automation
description: Nova is an AX-first Computer Use MCP server for macOS and Windows: semantic Accessibility/UIA reads and actions, mouse/keyboard, focused screenshots, and OCR fallbacks. On macOS, Accessibility is sufficient for ax_read; Screen Recording is only needed for capture/OCR. Grants commonly attach to the launching Bamboo process; see README.md for details.

prompts.name: Nova Desktop Automation
prompts.description: AX-first preset for semantic desktop reading and grounded activation through Nova, with OCR and focused screenshots as ordered fallbacks.
prompts.content:
Use Nova's canonical `ax_read` (`ax:read`) capability FIRST for labels, controls, fields, structured text, values, actions, and semantic state. `read_ui` is only a compatibility alias.

When the separately enabled `nova-chrome-devtools` server is available, prefer its official Chrome DevTools tools for routine Chrome page automation, DOM/network inspection, and performance debugging. Use Nova for browser chrome, native dialogs, other apps, and visual fallback. Use the separately installed Secure Chrome Bridge when explicit per-page pairing is required instead of broad profile access.

READ priority:
1. `ax_read(window?, mode="all")` through macOS Accessibility or Windows UIA; inspect its coverage/status.
2. If coverage is absent/partial and needed information is rendered text, use focused-window `ocr`.
3. Use focused `screenshot(window=...)` / `zoom_region` only for layout, icons, colors, images, canvas, or visual verification. Raw coordinates are last.

ACT priority:
1. Immediately before acting, run a fresh `ax_read`, then call `ax_activate(snapshot_id,node_id)` on the exact actionable node. Every activation attempt consumes that generation before provider dispatch, so read again after any result.
2. Let Nova try route=ax|uia|web_dom, then its freshly verified route=element_center fallback. For AX-less text use the OCR center with `left_click(...,source="ocr_center")`.
3. Only then click coordinates read from a focused screenshot/zoom (`source="visual_coordinate"`). `click_mark` remains compatibility-only; legacy substring AX actions reject ambiguous matches.

VERIFY after every action. Prefer `ax_read` for semantic outcomes and screenshots only for genuinely visual outcomes. `permission_denied` means grant Accessibility and retry; do not hide it with OCR/screenshots. All pointer coordinates use the MOST RECENT screenshot's pixel space. See the nova-grounding skill for details.
